newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan shares slide to lower close on French fears.
newsitem.headline: Milan shares slide to lower close on French fears.

text.p: Italian shares turned tail and gave up early gains to end lower on Wednesday as worries over a left wing victory in Sunday's French election took hold while a lower start on Wall Street did little to bolster confidence.

Shares took fright, along with domestic bonds and the lira, as French stocks slumped on talk that private opinion polls were showing the opposition Socialists well placed to gain in Sunday's parliamentary election run-off. This again reinforced worries that EMU may not start on time in 1999.
The all-share Mibtel index ended off 0.77 percent at 12,242 and the blue chip Mib30 0.93 percent down at 18,201.

Olivetti was off 1.5 percent at 500.1 lire even after a denial of a newspaper report that the group was planning to cut its 35.5 percent stake in mobile phone consortium Omnitel. "The investment in Omnitel is, for Olivetti, a strategic fact and there will be no type of downsizing", Olivetti said.
Italy's largest food group Parmalat ended off 4.71 percent at 2,410 lire on reports it was considering an acquisition in Australia and also it may make a move for Ault Foods in Canada.
Parmalat said it had made no decision on Ault which is the subject of a hostile bid approach. Early this year, Parmalat bought a controlling stake in Canadian group Beatrice Foods.

Among banks, Credito Italiano ended off 1.29 percent at 2,525 lire after a newspaper interview with managing director Alessandro Profumo. He said the bank was not planning, at least in the short-term, to buy stakes in other banking groups.
San Paolo continued to fluctuate after its share offer closed last Friday. They were off 0.33 percent at 10,636 lire.

Insurer INA showed a 1.05 percent gain to 2,404 lire after the group reported a 22.6 percent rise in 1996 consolidated net profits late Tuesday. Although it said results for the first four months of 1997 were ahead of budget, INA added its results for the whole of 1997 could be lower than 1996.
